tools.name: check_domain
tools.description: Live check whether domains are free to register, with prices (EUR) for 1-3 years and a cart link. Works for .al, .com.al, .net.al, .org.al, .edu.al and international extensions sold by Host.al (.com, .net, .org, .eu, .io ...). Up to 10 domains per call.

items.description: A full domain name with its extension, e.g. "mybrand.al"

domains.description: Domain names to check (1-10), each with its extension, e.g. ["mybrand.al", "mybrand.com.al", "mybrand.com"]. "https://" and "www." are removed automatically.

tools.name: get_domain_prices
tools.description: Registration and transfer prices (EUR) per extension, and who may register each .al extension (e.g. .al: anyone from any country; .com.al: Albanian companies or foreign brands via free local presence).

tld.description: Optional, e.g. ".al" or "com.al"; omit for all

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Host.al products with EUR prices, billing cycle, specs, location and order link: VPS (Tirana, Skopje, Kansas City), dedicated servers (Tirana, Skopje, Thessaloniki, Nuremberg, Kansas City), colocation in Tirana, IP transit 1/10 Gbps, free BGP session for your ASN, IPv4 lease, web hosting, SSL, Exchange e-mail.

category.description: Optional product type: web-hosting, vps, dedicated-server, colocation, ip-transit, network (free BGP session for your ASN, IPv4 lease), ssl or email. Omit for all products.

max_price_eur.description: Only plans at or below this price (per billing period)

tools.name: get_order_link
tools.description: A link that opens the Host.al cart (my.host.al) with a domain registration/transfer or a product already added. Give it to the user: they sign in and pay there.

action.description: With "domain": "register" for a new domain (use when check_domain says available), "transfer" to move a domain the user already owns to Host.al.

tools.name: search_help
tools.description: Answers from Host.al support (help centre): .al domains (registration, AKEP approval, transfers, EPP codes, owner changes), DNS and nameservers, web hosting (Plesk), email, SSL, VPS (VirtFusion panel, reinstall, SSH, traffic, IPs, port 25, BGP), dedicated servers (delivery, iDRAC/IPMI), colocation, billing and payments (Pago, PayPal, invoices, refunds) and account security (2FA). Returns the best matching questions with full answers and a link to each answer. Use it before telling a user to contact support.

query.description: The user's question or keywords, e.g. "transfer .al domain", "change nameservers", "VPS root password", "fiscal invoice"

language.description: Language of the answers: "en" English or "sq" Albanian

tools.name: get_help_topic
tools.description: All questions and answers of one help centre topic, or the list of topics when no topic is given. Topics: domains, dns-nameservers, hosting, email, ssl, vps, dedicated-servers, colocation, billing-payments, account-security, general.

topic.description: Topic slug, e.g. "vps" or "domains"; omit to list the topics

tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: Facts about Host.al: accreditation (AKEP, ICANN), number of .al domains, datacenter in Tirana, network AS213683 and peering, locations, certifications, contact and support.
